title: Monochromatic $k$ in a row
summary: We study a variant of the $k$-in-a-row game in which players alternatively claim positions until a $k$-in-a-row is created among all claimed positions. This leads to the constraint near $k$-in-a-row avoiding on configurations and the associated problem of determining their extremal densities of such configurations. We investigate this problem on two types of boards: the grid $\mathbb{Z}^2$ and hypercubes $[k]^d$.
